newsitem.title: USA: Northrop gets $9.4 bln defense deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Northrop gets $9.4 bln defense deal - WSJ.

text.p: The U.S. Defense Department has authorized Northrop Grumman Corp to produce surveillance and communications planes in a deal worth $9.4 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.

The newspaper said the company will produce 19 high-tech, ground-surveillance radar and communications planes for the department in a deal that will provide it and its contractors with at least $4 billion in new revenue.
The amount is in addition to nearly $5.3 billion already committed for research and development and initial production, it said.
The newspaper said the department's approval came days after the General Accounting Office criticized Northrop's "Joint Stars" program, urging a delay in the production of the planes.
